_note: Play screens for the plain-wales pass (docs/design/plain-wales.md sections 3, 4 and 7). Plain words, reading age 11, no sentence over 18 words.
steps.label: This turn, in four steps
score.label: How Wales is doing
score.tip_life: The average of the 7 bars, out of 100. It shows how people are living now.
score.tip_left: The average of the 7 small 2050 markers, out of 100. Cards on their way count too. Loans lower it.
score.rule: Your result is the weaker of the two. Spending the future to look good now does not win.
trust.line_next.one: Trust: {band}. Next turn you can play 1 card.
trust.line_next.other: Trust: {band}. Next turn you can play {n} cards.
trust.line_lost: Trust: {band}. You are out of office next turn.
trust.line_out: You are out of office this turn. A stand-in plays the cards.
trust.line_final: Trust: {band}. That was the last turn.
trust.tip: Trust goes up when people see results and you keep promises. It goes down when things slip.
budget.title: Your coins this turn
budget.aria: {total} coins: {spent} on cards, {fund} in the emergency fund, {unused} not used yet.
budget.coin_is: A coin is one eighth of what a government can newly choose to spend in 4 years.
budget.coin_more: There are no pound figures. Costs are counted in coins so the choices stay clear.
budget.save_line: A crisis can use 2 coins. Up to 2 more carry over to next turn. You have saved {n}.
budget.save_line_first: No crisis can come in your first turn. Up to 2 saved coins carry over. You have saved {n}.
budget.save_line_last: This is the last turn. A crisis can use 2 coins. Nothing carries over after 2050. You have saved {n}.
budget.save_lost: This coin would be lost. Spend it instead.
budget.first_turn: No crisis can come in your first turn. Spend what you can. Up to 2 saved coins carry over.
endturn.title: Before 4 years pass
endturn.save.one: Save 1 for a crisis and end the turn
endturn.save.other: Save {n} for a crisis and end the turn
endturn.save_note: A crisis can use up to 2. If none comes, they carry over to next turn.
endturn.save_note_some: A crisis can use up to 2. If none comes, only {carry} carry over. The rest are lost.
endturn.save_note_last: This is the last turn. A crisis can use up to 2. Nothing carries over.
endturn.lose.one: End the turn and lose 1 coin
endturn.lose.other: End the turn and lose {n} coins
endturn.first_turn: No crisis can come in your first turn. Only 2 saved coins can carry over.
endturn.card_open: {card} is not played yet. Play it now, or it goes back in the deck.
endturn.no_cards: You have not played a card. Wales gets a little worse on its own every turn.
card.up_unsure.one: {goal} probably goes up about 1 point by {year}.
card.up_unsure.other: {goal} probably goes up about {n} points by {year}.
card.down_unsure.one: {goal} probably goes down about 1 point by {year}.
card.down_unsure.other: {goal} probably goes down about {n} points by {year}.
card.left_more: It also adds to what is left for 2050: {goals}.
card.left_less: It uses up some of what is left for 2050: {goals}.
card.small_hurts: It can pull {goals} down a little.
card.small_mixed: In some places it helps {goals}. In others it hurts.
card.too_small: Across Wales the change is too small to move the bars.
card.partner: On its own it changes nothing. It makes your other cards in those regions work better.
card.after_2050: Works after 2050. Too late for your years. It still counts in Left for 2050.
card.nothing_seen: You will not see a change by 2050.
card.choose_where: Choose where: a region below, or click one on the map.
card.choose_two_done: Two regions chosen. Now press Play.
card.cannot_afford: Not enough coins left for this card.
guide.how2: Spend coins on cards. Cards change Wales. Some work now. Some take years.
guide.how3: The 7 bars at the top show how Wales is doing.
guide.slow_note: This will slowly push {goal} down. You can push back.
guide.hand: Start with this one. It works straight away.
guide.card: This card needs a place. The map shows where floods threaten the most homes. Click a region.
guide.card_most: Most homes at flood risk are in {region}.
guide.region_chosen: If you play this: about {n} out of 10 by 2030 (now {m}).
guide.slow: This one is slow. You pay now. It works from 2034. Slow cards often do the most good.
guide.coins_left.one: You have 1 coin left. Play another card, or save it. No crisis can come in your first turn, so spending is the better move. Up to 2 saved coins carry over.
guide.coins_left.other: You have {n} coins left. Play another card, or save some. No crisis can come in your first turn, so spending is the better move. Up to 2 saved coins carry over.
guide.result_because: Because of {card}. You played it in {year}.
guide.result_small: {goal}: still {n} out of 10. {card} helped, but by less than a whole point.
guide.on_way: {card} is on its way. It works from {year}. Nothing to see yet.
guide.why: Press Why? on anything that changed.
guide.trust: Trust goes up when people see results and you keep promises. It goes down when things slip.
guide.handoff: That is the whole game: spend coins, wait, see what changed, ask why. Next turn someone asks you for a promise, and a place asks you to visit.
guide.promise: Someone asks you for a promise. Keep it and Trust goes up. Break it and Trust falls.
guide.visit_rhondda: The Rhondda wants you to come. You will choose which coal tips to make safe first. There is not enough money for all of them.
guide.visit_bethesda: Bethesda wants you to come. You will choose what to do first. You cannot do everything.
guide.marker: Some cards build things that last. The 2050 marker shows what will be left.
guide.crisis.one: A crisis. You saved 1 coin. Spend it to cut the damage, or do nothing.
guide.crisis.other: A crisis. You saved {n} coins. Spend them to cut the damage, or do nothing.
guide.crisis_none: A crisis. You saved no coins, so all of it lands this time.
guide.upkeep: Something you built needs care this turn. Skip it and it starts to fail. See Borrowing and bills.
guide.borrow: Short of coins? You can borrow or skip repairs. Both have a catch.
guide.lost: You lost the election. A stand-in runs Wales for 4 years. You can still make one promise.
result.lost.one: 1 coin was not used and is gone.
result.lost.other: {n} coins were not used and are gone.
result.all_spent: You spent every coin on cards.
result.ready: A card you played had made Wales ready. Part of the hit was stopped.
promise.no_card: No card you hold can help {goal} this turn. A promise you cannot keep costs Trust.
promise.cards: Cards that can help it this turn: {cards}.
visit.questions: Before you choose: the 3 questions people here will ask
visit.q.exposure: Will your picks protect most of the homes below the tips?
visit.q.fairness: Will they protect the poorest streets?
visit.q.lifelines: Will they protect the schools and the railway?
visit.q.aros: Can young people afford to stay?
visit.q.iaith: Will Welsh still be heard on the street?
visit.q.pwysau: Is it more than the valley can carry?
end.score: Wales scored about {start} out of 100 in 2026. You hand on about {end}.
end.score_lived: Wales scored about {start} out of 100 in 2026. Life in your years averaged about {end}.
end.why_left: Life in your years held up, but less was left for 2050. The biggest reason: {cause}.
end.why_lived: You left more for 2050, but people had hard years on the way. {from} to {to} was the hardest turn.
end.why_lived_plain: You left more for 2050, but life in your years was weaker.
end.why_both: Things slipped in your years and less was left behind. The biggest reason: {cause}.
end.why_up: Both scores rose. The biggest reason: {cause}.
end.why_coins: You left {n} coins unused over {t} turns. Wales gets worse on its own when nothing is done.
end.part_life_level: Life in your years held level.
end.m_shock_saved: The {year} crisis, {name}: you spent {n} coins to cut the damage.
end.m_shock_none: The {year} crisis, {name}, hit in full: you had saved nothing.
end.m_shock_ready: The {year} crisis, {name}: your cards had made Wales ready.
end.m_visit_good: You went to {place} in {year}. It went {grade}.
end.m_visit_bad: You went to {place} in {year}. It went {grade}.
end.m_promise_kept: You promised {goal} in {year} and kept it.
end.m_promise_broken: You promised {goal} in {year} and broke it.
end.m_lost_turn: You lost the election in {year}. A stand-in ran Wales for 4 years.
end.m_coins: You left {n} coins unused over {t} turns.
end.autopilot_ahead: On autopilot, the same Wales would have ended at about {n}. You finished ahead by about {d}.
end.autopilot_behind: On autopilot, the same Wales would have ended at about {n}. You finished behind by about {d}.
end.autopilot_level: On autopilot, the same Wales would have ended at about {n}. You finished about level.
end.autopilot_note: Autopilot is the same Wales, with the same events, and a stand-in who only plays the cheapest cards.
end.left_note: What you hand on to the people of 2050
end.next_slow: Next time: play one slow card in your first turn.
end.next_save: Next time: save 2 coins when a crisis could come.
end.next_spend: Next time: spend your coins. Unused coins do nothing for Wales.
end.next_visit: Next time: go when a place asks for you.
end.next_left: Next time: play more cards that last. They count in Left for 2050.
end.next_life: Next time: play some cards that work straight away.
end.next_promise: Next time: only promise a goal your cards can help.
end.next_loans: Next time: pay back your loans. A loan left in 2050 lowers Left for 2050.
end.next_left_early: Next time: play your lasting cards earlier. They get more years to work.
end.next_beat: Next time: try to hand on more than {n}.
end.new_game_note: A new game: different cards and events.
title.line2: Leave it better than you found it. In 2050 a young person writes to tell you how you did.
title.note: About 20 minutes. 6 turns of 4 years. Every figure on the map is real.
why.book: Read this rule in the rule book
end.copy_link: Copy the link to this game
